title: Skill-JEPA: Learning Planner-Aligned Action Spaces for World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn from pixels to predict the outcome of actions in a latent space. To reach a goal, a planner samples many candidate action sequences, uses the model to predict where each one leads, and executes the best one. However, standard planners draw their candidates from a Gaussian, while the model has only seen the structured, state-dependent actions of its training data. Its predictions for such candidates are unreliable, and planning fails more often as goals move farther away. We propose Skill-JEPA, which learns an action space aligned with the planner. A variational autoencoder conditioned on the current state encodes short action sequences into latent skills with a standard Gaussian prior, and decodes them back into actions. The world model predicts the effect of skills rather than raw actions, and the planner searches over skills starting from that same Gaussian,

translated_title: Skill-JEPA：为世界模型学习与规划器对齐的动作空间
translated_abstract: 基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型从像素中学习，在潜空间中预测动作产生的结果。为了达成目标，规划器会采样大量候选动作序列，利用模型预测每个序列的最终结果，并执行其中最优的一个。然而，标准规划器从高斯分布中抽取候选动作，而模型在其训练数据中只见过结构化的、依赖状态的动作，因此模型对此类候选动作的预测并不可靠，随着目标距离变远，规划失败的频率也会增加。我们提出了Skill-JEPA，它学习一个与规划器对齐的动作空间。一个以当前状态为条件的变分自编码器将短动作序列编码为具有标准高斯先验的潜技能，并将其解码回动作。世界模型预测技能的效果而非原始动作，规划器则从同一个高斯分布出发在技能空间中进行搜索。
tldr: Skill-JEPA通过状态条件变分自编码器将短动作序列编码为符合标准高斯先验的潜技能，让世界模型预测技能效果、规划器在同一高斯分布上搜索技能，从而解决了规划器采样动作与模型训练动作分布不匹配导致预测不可靠、远距离目标规划易失败的问题。
en_tdlr: Skill-JEPA aligns the planner with the world model by using a state-conditioned variational autoencoder to encode short action sequences into latent skills with a standard Gaussian prior, enabling the world model to predict skill effects and the planner to search over skills from that same Gaussian, thus overcoming unreliable predictions for out-of-distribution action candidates.
